items.text: San Francisco (early week): OUT/IR - DL Gracen Halton (fractured/dislocated ankle). Likely OUT - WR Mike Evans (not expected ready). Day-to-day - CB Renardo Green (back), CB Deommodore Lenoir (foot). Expected back at practice - WR Deebo Samuel, DL C.J. West. Brock Purdy starts.

Dallas (early week): OUT - TE Jake Ferguson (knee, multiple weeks), S P.J. Locke (concussion). Questionable - WR George Pickens (hamstring, inactive Wk9; 'chances are good'), CB Joey Porter Jr. (ankle, inactive Wk9), LB DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring/back), WR KaVontae Turpin (ribs). Dak Prescott starts.
items.source: Yahoo Sports (Cowboys face injury decisions ahead of Week 10, Nov 10)
